attributes.board_name: Maine Board of Speech, Audiology and Hearing (Office of Professional and Occupational Regulation)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Unlimited: live seminars, workshops, institutes and in-service sessions; accredited academic courses; distance learning with immediate instructor interaction. Max 4 hours combined: first-time presentations, published book/peer-reviewed article, commercial home study, distance learning without instructor interaction. Content must directly relate to SLP or audiology (incl. ethics and supervision training); marketing, business, self-improvement, lay-person activities, case conferences, grand rounds and tours do not count
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial license issued in the first 6 months of the license year: 5 hours for the first renewal; issued in the second 6 months: no CE for the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Certification of CE at renewal is subject to audit under OPOR Chapter 13 (Uniform Rule for the Substantiation of Continuing Education Requirements).
rules.notes: Annual license, fixed renewal date February 28 (February 29 in leap years). Dually licensed SLP and audiologist: 16 hours per year. One hour = one hour of actual instructional time. CE does not apply to inactive licensees; return from inactive status needs 10 hours (under 5 years) or 20 hours (5+ years) in the prior 365 days.

The board's CE chapter (02-643 ch. 8 §1) states its provisions do not apply to speech-language pathology assistants, temporary SLPs or trainee hearing aid dealers. SLPA licenses expire annually at the end of February and require documented supervision by a Maine-licensed SLP (ch. 9).
